create_TestMeter: create a TestMeter instance to aggregate multi-clip video predictions with sum or max ensemble
run_TestMeter_update_stats: run TestMeter update_stats to collect batch predictions and perform on-the-flight summation ensemble
finalize_TestMeter_metrics: finalize TestMeter metrics to calculate top-k accuracy or mAP for multi-label classification
create_ScalarMeter: create a ScalarMeter with a window size deque to track scalar values and compute median or average
compute_get_map: compute mean average precision for multi-label predictions using numpy arrays of preds and labels
